config.label: OrcaRouter API key
config.description: OrcaRouter API key. Required only for orcarouter_chat. Catalog tools (orcarouter_models_list, orcarouter_model_card, orcarouter_providers_list) work without it.

config.label: Override the gateway base URL
config.description: Override the gateway base URL. Defaults to https://api.orcarouter.ai.

config.label: Per-request timeout in seconds
config.description: Per-request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 300 (5 minutes) to accommodate long reasoning-model completions.
